subject: Streaming session fallback playbook & timeout surge — coordinating mitigation
messages:
From: Arjun Rao <arjun@mediasync.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: Clients hitting streaming timeouts / 429s in production

Hi Priya / Grace,

We're seeing a persistent spike in 429s and streaming session aborts since ~08:50 PT this morning. Rough summary: ~12% of live sessions are getting a client-side timeout within the first 30s of a streaming completion, many of them correlate with a flurry of 429 responses from your gateway. When the client receives 429 it retries aggressively (1s retries) which appears to amplify the issue.

Impact: real-time customers (LiveCaption product) are experiencing dropped captions and session restarts — this is visible in our monitoring as a 15% drop in successful heartbeats. Our SREs attached a CSV with sample session IDs and timestamps.

Can you confirm whether this is on your end (autoscaling / queueing) or if something changed on the client? We need an immediate mitigation we can apply today.

Attachments: session_ids.csv (50 rows: session_id,timestamp,status)

--
Arjun Rao
CTO, MediaSync
arjun@mediasync.ai
+1 415-555-0199
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Arjun Rao <arjun@mediasync.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: Clients hitting streaming timeouts / 429s in production

Thanks Arjun — really sorry for the disruption. We see the same signal in our dashboards and are treating this as P1. Immediate next steps I'm coordinating:

- Marcus + infra will grab traces for the exact session IDs you provided (Marcus, can you pull KV/cache traces + gateway logs for the 08:40-09:10 window).
- Grace will set up a warp room with MediaSync SREs for a focused triage call in 30m.
- As a short-term mitigation, we'd like your permission to enable two fallbacks for affected sessions today: 1) server-side 429 burst suppression (suppress repeated 429s for 5s), 2) fallback to non-streaming completions for any session that fails 2 streaming attempts. This would reduce client retries immediately.

Can you confirm we have permission to apply those temporary settings? We'll log all changes and roll them back once traffic normalizes.

Priya
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arjun Rao <arjun@mediasync.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: Clients hitting streaming timeouts / 429s in production

Priya / Grace / Arjun — preliminary findings below (short summary, full logs attached).

What I see:
- Gateway autoscaler hit a connection limit on a small subset of nodes between 08:42–08:57 PT.
- When gateway returned 429 we saw immediate client-side retries at 1s intervals and several clients re-opened streaming sessions concurrently (retry storm). This created a queue buildup in the runtime leader which increased tail latency for streaming completions.
- Not a model hang — completions complete when scheduled, but tail latency spikes and dropped websockets due to aggressive retries.

Attachments: trace_dump.txt (gateway+runtime trace spans for 30 sessions)

Short-term mitigations I can push now (30m window):
1) Enable 429 burst suppression at the gateway layer for MediaSync: aggregate per-session 429 suppression window = 5s.
2) Open temporary higher connection ceiling for their tenant (bump from 400 -> 1200 connections per pool) to relieve queueing.
3) Server-side backoff: add token-bucket throttle to reject retry loops instead of letting them requeue the runtime.

Longer-term: we should push a client guidance doc recommending exponential backoff with jitter (baseline 200ms -> 500ms-> 1s), and implement server-initiated Retry-After hints in streaming responses.

If Priya approves, I'll roll the three config changes.

—Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Arjun Rao <arjun@mediasync.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: Clients hitting streaming timeouts / 429s in production

Arjun — thanks for the samples. We're on a 30-min call at 10:15 PT to walk through traces and apply a short mitigation. Priya, Marcus: please confirm you have what you need for the call.

Also Arjun — if we apply the temporary fallbacks and bump the connection ceiling, we may need to provision credit for excess usage today. I'll follow up with finance once we know the scale.

Grace
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Arjun Rao <arjun@mediasync.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Escalation to execs: MediaSync production impact / ask for expedited mitigation & credits

Folks — following the triage yesterday and the temporary changes Marcus pushed, MediaSync is seeing reduced tail latency but we still have intermittent spikes during peak load that correlate with client retry patterns. Impact window yesterday caused ~12% degraded sessions for ~90 minutes. MediaSync is asking for the following:

- Immediate: apply mitigation-patch.diff (attached) to add server-side retry hints and a 2nd-layer backoff at the runtime within 24 hours.
- Commercial: one-time service credit of $9,000 to offset disrupted sessions and engineering overtime.
- Executive: MediaSync wants an SLA review and assurance that we will prioritize a permanent fix (INF-2219).

Marcus, can you confirm the patch scope and estimated dev time? Stephanie, can you help coordinate a commercial approval path for the credit and expedite INF-2219? I'll need a quick sign-off to tell MediaSync we have both technical and commercial commitments.

Priya
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Priya: communicate to Arjun that we will: 1) implement the mitigation patch within 24 hours, 2) apply an immediate config change to suppress 429 bursts (already in place), and 3) issue a $9,000 credit to MediaSync.

Stephanie Nguyen
